- When sentiment is consistently bullish (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction by 2–5% for 30d forecasts.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >+10% from prior 10d mean), model often overshoots; reduce forecast slope by 10–20% for next 5–7 days.
- If official supply net is negative and bullish sentiment is low, model underestimates; add 3–7% upward bias to forecast mean.
- When sentiment is mixed or bearish (≤0.33) and supply net is negative, model underestimates; apply upward bias of 5–10% to offset mean reversion.
- For 30d forecasts with high event count and negative supply net, model tends to lag; add 1–3% upward bias to offset delayed reaction.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model fails to capture mean reversion; adjust forecast to align with 10d moving average of true prices.
- When recent auction events are CAP3 EU/PL, model overreacts to supply; reduce forecast by 2–5% for 3–5 days post-event.
